description: Four A/B switches on one panel, each sending one input to one of two outputs

params.text: Latches that switch between its A and B outputs, and is ignored while a cable is patched to that switch's select input

inputs.text: Sends that switch to its B output while this reads above 0V and to its A output otherwise, and stops that switch's button working while a cable is patched here

outputs.text: Carries the input while that switch is set to A, and 0V while it is set to B
Carries the input while that switch is set to B, and 0V while it is set to A

notes: a switch does nothing at all until a cable is patched to its own signal input: with that input empty neither of its outputs is written and both hold whatever they last carried
